cohort: Live-born term singleton infants with a birth weight ≥4000 g, admitted at Tianjin Medical University General Hospital between 2010 and 2013.
finding: Macrosomic infants of diabetic mothers (IDMs) are at an increased risk for adverse neonatal outcomes compared to macrosomic infants of non-diabetic mothers.
mod_finding: The study found that a significantly higher proportion of IDMs were delivered via cesarean section compared to non-IDMs (87.72% vs 68.51%).
